SpinTel questions

What is the cheapest SpinTel NBN plan?

NBN 25/10 at $41/mo for 6 months, then $69.95/mo. That is $665.70 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Does SpinTel let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. SpinTel only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give SpinTel 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. SpinTel asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.

Has SpinTel raised its prices recently?

We haven't recorded any ongoing price rises for SpinTel since 14 July 2026. Promo prices have changed; see the table above.
